title: Master Services and SaaS Agreement
text: This Master Services Agreement ('Agreement') is entered into as of January 15, 2025. 1. Term and Termination: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon ninety (90) days prior written notice to the other party. 2. Most Favored Customer: Provider represents and warrants that the pricing, service levels, and discounts granted to Customer hereunder are no less favorable than those offered to any other customer purchasing similar volumes. In the event Provider grants more favorable terms to any third party, Provider shall immediately extend such terms to Customer ('Most Favored Nation'). 3. Exclusivity: Customer agrees that during the Term, Provider shall be the exclusive software supplier for Customer's enterprise compliance workflow. 4. Limitation of Liability: Except for gross negligence or willful misconduct, each party's aggregate liability arising under this Agreement shall be capped at the total fees paid by Customer in the preceding twelve (12) months ('Cap On Liability').

title: Executive Employment and Restrictive Covenant Agreement
text: Executive Agreement: During the term of employment and for a period of twelve (12) months following termination of employment for any reason, Executive shall not directly or indirectly engage in, perform services for, or invest in any business that competes with the Company ('Non-Compete'). Executive shall not solicit or hire any employees of Company for twenty-four (24) months ('No-Solicit Of Employees'). Single Trigger Change of Control: Upon the consummation of a Change of Control transaction, all outstanding unvested equity options held by Executive shall immediately accelerate and become 100% vested ('Change Of Control'). All inventions, proprietary software, and patents conceived by Executive during employment are the sole property of Company ('IP Ownership Assignment').

title: Senior Secured Credit and Guarantee Agreement
text: Credit Agreement dated November 10, 2024. Borrower shall maintain minimum unrestricted liquidity of $5,000,000 at all times. Events of Default: Failure to pay principal when due, or any Change of Control without Lender prior written consent, shall constitute an immediate Event of Default. Anti-Assignment: Borrower may not assign, transfer, or delegate any of its rights or obligations hereunder without the prior written consent of Administrative Agent. Audit Rights: Administrative Agent and its representatives shall have the right upon reasonable notice during regular business hours to examine and audit Borrower's financial records and collateral.

title: Solar Energy Power Purchase Agreement (PPA)
text: Solar PPA: Seller agrees to sell and Buyer agrees to purchase 100% of the net electrical energy generated by the solar energy facility at a fixed rate of $45.00 per MWh with an annual price adjustment of 2.0% ('Price Adjustment'). Revenue Sharing: To the extent facility participates in ancillary grid services, Seller and Buyer shall split net revenue on a 50/50 basis ('Revenue/Profit Sharing'). Term: The initial term shall be twenty (20) years from the Commercial Operation Date, with two successive five-year renewal options ('Renewal Term').

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Pure Negative Controls)
text: Mutual NDA: The parties agree to hold confidential information in strict confidence and use it solely for evaluating a potential transaction. Neither party grants any license under its patents or copyrights. This agreement does not create any exclusivity, partnership, or obligation to proceed with any transaction. Governing Law: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
